Lessons.Title: Ten Times as Many
ExplanationParagraphs:
Learning goal: You will represent and solve multiplicative comparison problems involving multiples of 10.
In this lesson, you apply place value understanding, where you look for and make use of structure, to what you have learned about representing and solving multiplicative comparison problems (MP7). You use tape diagrams and equations to represent multiplicative comparisons that are “10 times as many”.
Core relationship: Tenfold multiplicative relationships. Multiply by ten to compare a quantity that is ten times the original.

Local publisher 2021 source lesson activities: Warm-up:  Choral Count: 12, 15 and 24	 (10 minutes); Activity 1:  Ten Times as Many	 (20 minutes); Activity 2:  What Remains the Same?	 (15 minutes); Cool-down:  What’s the Value?	 (5 minutes)
Source-aligned Edulytics model: What is ten times 128?
First-party Cool-down (not gated original): Ten times 406 equals what number?
Original visual/physical and peer-explanation activities still require teacher review.
